svg.title: SYN Mirror: the packets, byte by byte
svg.text: Every packet: UDP, its payload alone - told apart by its length and its first 16 bytes
→ the port of requests of S
→ the port of requests of S
A wrong one - another length, a key not of the settings - gets no answer, and counts as a wrong password
Each answer is shorter than its request: the meeting point multiplies the traffic of nobody
A port: 2 bytes, high first · an address: 4 bytes · the id: 8 random bytes of the server, the same in all its packets
